user.description: System user account under which the exporter process runs.

group.description: System group for the exporter process.

listen_address.description: IP address the exporter listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' to listen on all interfaces.

listen_port.description: TCP port the exporter listens on for Prometheus scrapes.

vty_socket_path.description: Path to the FRR vty socket used to query routing protocol state.

daemons_config_path.description: Optional path to FRR's daemons configuration file. If set, enables per-daemon metrics.

debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging for troubleshooting.

daemons.description: List of FRR daemons to scrape. Use ['all'] to scrape all enabled daemons, or specify a subset (e.g., ['bgp', 'isis']).

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for responses from the FRR vty socket.

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS (HTTPS) for the exporter metrics endpoint.

tls_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the TLS certificate file (required if TLS is enabled).

tls_key_path.description: Absolute path to the TLS private key file (required if TLS is enabled).
